# ghost/files

Android Files (DocumentsUI): list a folder, search files by name, create a folder in internal storage. No account needed.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/files
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/files list_folder --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/files search_files --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/files create_folder --device <serial> --param name=<name>
```

## Actions

- `list_folder`: What's in my Download folder?
- `search_files`: Find the file called notes
- `create_folder`: Make a folder called Receipts in Documents
